name: Arnold Henry
original_name: アーノルド・ヘンリー
source:
Auditor

An auditor who boarded the ship alongside Amamiya.
He has a carefree personality and quickly bonded with the crew, regardless of his position.
However, there are many mysteries surrounding his actions.
